name: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria 38.3 Test T.2 thermal cycling of lithium cells/batteries (+72 C / -40 C, 6 h or 12 h dwells, 10 cycles), preceded in the sequence by T.1 altitude simulation at 11.6 kPa
plain_name: Bake and freeze a lithium battery ten times to prove it is safe to ship
description: Transport-qualification thermal test for lithium-ion cells and EV/automotive batteries: storage for 6 h (12 h for large cells/batteries) at +72 C, then 6 h (12 h) at -40 C, repeated for 10 cycles. In the UN 38.3 sequence the same samples first undergo T.1 altitude simulation (storage at 11.6 kPa for more than 6 h), recorded here only as optional (non-mandatory) requirements for a machine that would run both steps.
keywords: Bake and freeze a lithium battery ten times to prove it is safe to ship

sources.citation: TUV SUD, UN/DOT 38.3 testing for lithium cells and batteries (summary of UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, sub-section 38.3, tests T1-T8)

requirements.rationale: The thermal test alternates the battery between +72 C (345.15 K) and -40 C (233.15 K); the test space must reach both extremes.
Optional: T.1 altitude simulation, run on the same samples before T.2, stores them in an evacuated chamber; only needed if one machine performs both steps.
Optional: T.1 requires holding the samples at 11.6 kPa (11600 Pa) or lower for more than 6 h.
